intro: Togo has about 9 million people from around 40 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: The Ewe live mainly in the south and the Kabye in the north. French is official; Ewe and Kabye are national languages. Christianity, Islam and traditional religions are all practised.

chapters.title: Lomé
text: Lomé, the capital, sits right on the border with Ghana.

keyTerms.meaning: A people of Togo and Ghana.
